body:
#4305 BUG-2696 (APPROVED, head a5b4a5e4, round 8, spec needs-attention) is RED on ci:full, three distinct failures, not flakes (main 23c989cd is green):
1. pr_cmd::bug_2203_refs_subject_tests::bug_2203_refs_subject_ship_appends_no_trailer_and_completes_nothing: "a Refs id must never complete: [BUG-999 Done, BUG-2169 Done]". "Completion independent of trailer" now completes Refs ids, breaking the BUG-2203 contract.
2. status_sections::bug_1633_pull_push_followups_tests::bug_1633_pull_followup_filed_only_remotely_is_not_refiled (line 461): parent expected Completed but is not.
3. auto_bump_done_tests::bug_2696_r4_failing_store_probe_never_reports_propagation:6493: the PR's own test; "git rev-parse HEAD failed: bad config line 1 in .git/config". The lane self-review called it environment-only and deferred it to CI. CI fails the same way, so it's the test.
Item 1 is a design fork: should a Done spec named only in Refs ever complete? That's your call. My recommendation: PARK #4305 at cap (8 rounds) and split. Keep the narrow Done-on-declared-completion fix, which must respect Refs semantics, and leave trailer independence for a separate slice. Don't land as-is.
Also: your relay mail says the advisor grant dd30ad99 expired at 15:08Z. Joe has to renew it from a terminal.
subject: #4305 BUG-2696 red: Refs ids now complete (BUG-2203 regression); recommend PARK
